text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is a yearly grand
event
where Umamusume of the classic
and senior years
compete for the
time-honored Autumn Shield.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This race holds particularly special
meaning for
each of the racers standing
in the paddock at this
moment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало, Спешл Уик, or Сэйун Скай.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Which of these Golden Generation
racers will lay
claim to both center stage
and the Autumn
Shield?
